subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared contract should Telegram, Discord, Gateway/session patching, and existing `/model ...@profile` behavior implement?
rationale: The lower-level auth-profile machinery already exists, but choosing how account choices appear, persist, and interact with auth-order/session stickiness is product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Define shared picker contract
options.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model that all supported channel pickers consume, with compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

options.title: Keep typed commands only
options.body: Declare `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and CLI auth-order commands as the supported account-switching path and close the picker feature intentionally.

options.title: Scope one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrower experiment in one channel while documenting that other channel pickers remain unchanged until the shared contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model that all supported channel pickers consume, with compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the broadest ownership across model picker, provider identity, and session override surfaces.
